title: The things we throw away 🗑️♻️🙀 Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
sentences.ko: 안녕하세요, Real Easy English에 오신 걸 환영해요.

sentences.en: In this podcast, we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
sentences.ko: 이 팟캐스트에서는 쉬운 영어로 진짜 대화를 나누며 공부를 도와요.

sentences.en: I'm Neil.
sentences.ko: 저는 닐이에요.

sentences.en: And I'm Beth.
sentences.ko: 그리고 저는 베스예요.

sentences.en: Did you know you can watch a video of this podcast on our website?
sentences.ko: 이 팟캐스트를 웹사이트에서 영상으로 볼 수 있다는 거 알았어요?

sentences.en: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: bbclearningenglish.com에 가 보세요.

sentences.en: Hi Beth, how are you today?
sentences.ko: 안녕, 베스, 오늘 어때요?

sentences.en: I'm very good, thank you, Neil. How are you?
sentences.ko: 아주 좋아요, 고마워요, 닐. 당신은요?

sentences.en: I'm very good. What are we talking about?
sentences.ko: 아주 좋아요. 오늘은 뭐에 대해 얘기해요?

sentences.en: Well, today we are talking about waste.
sentences.ko: 음, 오늘은 쓰레기(waste)에 대해 얘기해요.

sentences.en: So, that's what we call things that we don't want anymore, like rubbish or things that we've used, and we now don't need them.
sentences.ko: 더 이상 필요 없는 것들, 쓰레기나 이미 써서 이제 필요 없는 것들을 그렇게 불러요.

sentences.en: So, for example, after I've eaten some crisps as a snack, the... the packet is rubbish – it's waste.
sentences.ko: 예를 들어 간식으로 감자칩을 먹고 나면, 그 봉지는 쓰레기예요. 폐기물이죠.

sentences.en: Are you good at dealing with waste?
sentences.ko: 쓰레기 처리를 잘하는 편이에요?

sentences.en: I think so. I mean, at home we recycle.
sentences.ko: 그런 것 같아요. 집에서 재활용을 하거든요.

sentences.en: We can recycle glass, plastic, metal, card.
sentences.ko: 유리, 플라스틱, 금속, 종이 상자를 재활용할 수 있어요.

sentences.en: All the usual things that we recycle here in the UK. What about you?
sentences.ko: 영국에서 보통 재활용하는 것들 전부요. 당신은요?

sentences.en: Yeah, I do what I'm supposed to do.
sentences.ko: 네, 저도 해야 하는 건 해요.

sentences.en: So, we have a separate bin for different things – for plastic and for glass and for paper and for food.
sentences.ko: 플라스틱, 유리, 종이, 음식물별로 쓰레기통을 따로 써요.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.ko: 네.

sentences.en: When I was a kid, everything went in the same bin.
sentences.ko: 어렸을 땐 전부 같은 쓰레기통에 버렸어요.

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.ko: 정말요?

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.ko: 네.

sentences.en: And now that seems really crazy and really bad.
sentences.ko: 지금 생각하면 정말 말도 안 되고 정말 안 좋은 거죠.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.ko: 그렇죠.

sentences.en: So, I think we are better now at dealing with waste, but probably there's more things we could do.
sentences.ko: 그래서 지금은 쓰레기 처리를 더 잘하는 것 같지만, 아마 더 할 수 있는 게 있을 거예요.

sentences.en: Yeah, I would think so. Yeah.
sentences.ko: 네, 그럴 것 같아요.

sentences.en: Something that I do as well in... is when I'm in a supermarket, I try to not buy fruit and veg that's wrapped in plastic.
sentences.ko: 제가 또 하는 건, 슈퍼마켓에서 비닐로 포장된 과일과 채소를 안 사려고 하는 거예요.

sentences.en: I'll always try and buy the individual products like apples on their own, or, you know, a courgette.
sentences.ko: 사과 낱개나, 애호박 같은 낱개 상품을 사려고 늘 노력해요.

sentences.en: You don't need a courgette that's wrapped in plastic.
sentences.ko: 비닐로 싼 애호박은 필요 없잖아요.

sentences.en: Well, that's a good idea, but sometimes it's actually quite difficult to find things that aren't covered in plastic because we rely on plastic so much.
sentences.ko: 음, 좋은 생각이지만, 우리가 플라스틱에 너무 의존해서 사실 플라스틱으로 안 싸인 걸 찾기가 꽤 어려울 때가 있어요.

sentences.en: Yeah, I know that is true.
sentences.ko: 네, 그건 맞아요.

sentences.en: You know what people do these days, which is great, that they didn't used to do? Carry reusable water bottles.
sentences.ko: 요즘 사람들이 예전엔 안 했는데 하는 좋은 게 뭔지 알아요? 다회용 물병을 들고 다니는 거요.

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.ko: 맞아요.

sentences.en: Almost everybody carries a bottle.
sentences.ko: 거의 모두 물병을 들고 다녀요.

sentences.en: And just a few years ago, people bought plastic bottles of water all the time.
sentences.ko: 불과 몇 년 전만 해도 사람들이 늘 플라스틱 생수를 샀어요.

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember when I was teaching in a classroom and I'd sometimes have students.
sentences.ko: 네, 교실에서 가르칠 때가 기억나요.

sentences.en: They would come to London from all over the world, and every day they would go to a supermarket and buy a plastic bottle.
sentences.ko: 전 세계에서 런던에 온 학생들이 매일 슈퍼마켓에 가서 플라스틱 생수를 샀어요.

sentences.en: And I used to... I used to say sometimes, you know, 'Why? Buy a reusable one.'
sentences.ko: 그래서 가끔 말하곤 했어요. '왜 그래요? 다회용 물병을 사요.'

sentences.en: And then you're not using this plastic all the time.
sentences.ko: 그러면 플라스틱을 계속 쓰지 않아도 되잖아요.

sentences.en: Yeah. We have a word for that, don't we?
sentences.ko: 네. 그걸 부르는 말이 있죠?

sentences.en: Single-use plastic.
sentences.ko: 일회용 플라스틱이요.

sentences.en: Yeah. So we have to try and avoid single-use plastics.
sentences.ko: 네. 그러니까 일회용 플라스틱은 피하려고 노력해야 해요.

sentences.en: What about water?
sentences.ko: 물은 어때요?

sentences.en: So water waste.
sentences.ko: 물 낭비요.

sentences.en: I really like having a bath just to relax, but sometimes I feel really guilty about it because it's using up quite a lot of water.
sentences.ko: 저는 그냥 쉬려고 목욕하는 걸 정말 좋아하는데, 물을 꽤 많이 쓰니까 가끔 정말 죄책감이 들어요.

sentences.en: Yeah, I prefer showers, which is good because they use less water.
sentences.ko: 네, 저는 샤워가 더 좋아요. 물을 덜 쓰니까 다행이죠.

sentences.en: So, Beth, is there anything that you are planning to do to cut down further on the waste that you create?
sentences.ko: 베스, 만들어 내는 쓰레기를 더 줄이려고 계획하는 게 있어요?

sentences.en: I should probably have fewer baths.
sentences.ko: 목욕을 좀 줄여야 할 것 같아요.

sentences.en: I mean, I maybe have one a week, so... I mean, I shower too, of course.
sentences.ko: 일주일에 한 번쯤 하니까... 물론 샤워도 하고요.

sentences.en: But maybe I could have a bath less often.
sentences.ko: 그래도 목욕을 덜 자주 할 수 있겠죠.

sentences.en: Find other ways of relaxing which are less wasteful.
sentences.ko: 덜 낭비하는 다른 휴식 방법을 찾고요.

sentences.en: What about you? Anything you want to cut back on?
sentences.ko: 당신은요? 줄이고 싶은 게 있어요?

sentences.en: Yeah, I think, we talked about single-use plastic.
sentences.ko: 네, 일회용 플라스틱 얘기를 했잖아요.

sentences.en: You know, clingfilm, the very thin, like, sheet...
sentences.ko: 랩 있잖아요, 아주 얇은...

sentences.en: sheets of plastic that you wrap food in.
sentences.ko: 음식을 싸는 얇은 비닐이요.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.ko: 네.

sentences.en: I always feel bad when I use that stuff, but it's also really convenient and does its job well keeping a sandwich together or whatever.
sentences.ko: 그걸 쓸 때마다 늘 찜찜한데, 정말 편리하고 샌드위치 같은 걸 잘 싸 주는 역할도 잘해요.

sentences.en: But I don't like it, so I want to cut down on my use of clingfilm.
sentences.ko: 그래도 별로라서, 랩 사용을 줄이고 싶어요.

sentences.en: Let's recap the vocabulary we heard in this conversation.
sentences.ko: 이번 대화에서 들은 어휘를 정리해 봐요.

sentences.en: We had 'waste'. 'Waste' is things that are unwanted like rubbish, and we can also describe something as 'a waste' when someone uses something they don't need to, or they throw something away after not using it.
sentences.ko: 'waste'가 나왔어요. 'waste'는 쓰레기처럼 원하지 않는 것들이고, 누가 필요 없는 걸 쓰거나 안 쓰고 버리면 'a waste(낭비)'라고 표현할 수도 있어요.

sentences.en: So, for example, when my kids don't finish their dinner, that's a waste.
sentences.ko: 예를 들어 우리 아이들이 저녁을 다 안 먹으면, 그건 낭비예요.

sentences.en: We had 'single-use plastics'.
sentences.ko: 'single-use plastics'도 나왔어요.

sentences.en: These are plastic materials that we use once and then throw away.
sentences.ko: 한 번 쓰고 버리는 플라스틱 소재예요.

sentences.en: So, for example, food wrappers and shopping bags.
sentences.ko: 예를 들면 음식 포장지와 쇼핑백이요.

sentences.en: We heard 'recycle', which means to collect rubbish in order to make materials that can be used again.
sentences.ko: 'recycle'도 들었어요. 쓰레기를 모아서 다시 쓸 수 있는 소재로 만드는 거예요.

sentences.en: We can also describe something as 'recyclable'.
sentences.ko: 뭔가를 'recyclable'하다고도 할 수 있어요.

sentences.en: It means it can be recycled.
sentences.ko: 재활용될 수 있다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.en: It can be used again.
sentences.ko: 다시 쓸 수 있다는 거죠.

sentences.en: And we heard some common phrasal verbs that we use when talking about the environment.
sentences.ko: 그리고 환경에 대해 말할 때 자주 쓰는 구동사도 들었어요.

sentences.en: So, we had 'to rely on', which means need something in order to function.
sentences.ko: 'to rely on'은 제대로 돌아가려면 뭔가가 필요하다, 즉 의존한다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.en: For example, we rely on plastic a lot in our daily lives.
sentences.ko: 예를 들어 우리는 일상에서 플라스틱에 많이 의존해요.

sentences.en: We can also say 'cut down on', which means to reduce something.
sentences.ko: 'cut down on'이라고도 하는데, 뭔가를 줄인다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.en: And we also hear 'cut back on'.
sentences.ko: 그리고 'cut back on'이라고도 해요.

sentences.en: So, for example, I want to cut back on single-use plastic.
sentences.ko: 예를 들면 'I want to cut back on single-use plastic.'

sentences.en: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
sentences.ko: Real Easy English 이번 에피소드는 여기까지예요.

sentences.en: If you want to learn more phrasal verbs about the environment, then Georgie has made a whole video on this.
sentences.ko: 환경에 관한 구동사를 더 배우고 싶으면, 조지가 이걸로 영상을 하나 만들었어요.

sentences.en: You'll find the link in the notes below.
sentences.ko: 아래 설명란에 링크가 있어요.

sentences.en: See you then.
sentences.ko: 그때 만나요.

sentences.en: Bye!
sentences.ko: 안녕!
